# Asc <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Asc:Int32 string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. Only its first character counts. |

**Returns:** A code from 0 to 255, or -1 if the string is empty.

## Description

Returns the character code of the first character of a string. It is the opposite of [Chr](Chr).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Asc("A")
Print Asc("BCD")
```

```text
65
66
```
